business_problem: Mercedes-Benz needed a faster, easier way for production employees and quality engineers to analyze production and quality data, identify faults and malfunctions in real time, support daily production planning, and access insights without requiring complex programming skills.
solution_summary: Mercedes-Benz is testing ChatGPT in its MO360 digital production ecosystem as a production-facing AI interface for analyzing manufacturing and quality data. The implementation keeps production data in the MO360 Data Platform, which intelligently networks quality data from development, customer experience, and production. ChatGPT is integrated through Azure OpenAI Service and used as a universal voice- and chat-based interface so employees can query production-relevant data conversationally instead of writing complex code. In this workflow, the chatbot helps quality engineers cluster data, identify faults, simplify evaluations and presentations, and progressively narrow questions until the needed level of detail is reached. Mercedes-Benz also extends the same stack into the MO360 Support Bot, a self-service assistant available on company devices worldwide. Voice inputs are processed anonymously in the Azure cloud, while production data remains in MO360 under Mercedes-Benz control.

solution_components.name: MO360 Data Platform
solution_components.role: Retains production data and networks quality data from development, customer experience, and production for analysis.

solution_components.name: Azure OpenAI Service
solution_components.role: Integrates ChatGPT into Mercedes-Benz production workflows using Microsoft's enterprise-grade cloud and AI platform.

solution_components.name: ChatGPT
solution_components.role: Acts as the conversational interface for querying production and quality data, clustering faults, and simplifying evaluations for employees.

solution_components.name: MO360 Support Bot
solution_components.role: Provides an AI-based self-service contact point that answers employee questions through MO360 on company devices.

data_flow: Quality data from development, customer experience, and production is networked in the MO360 Data Platform. Employees query that data through ChatGPT, integrated via Azure OpenAI Service inside the MO360 digital production ecosystem. The chatbot narrows questions in dialogue, supports fault clustering and analysis, and returns evaluations and planning views to production staff, while voice inputs are anonymized in Azure and production data remains in MO360.
integration_points: Self-service portal on company devices including tablets, smartphones, and laptops
business_outcome: Mercedes-Benz says the implementation accelerates error identification, analysis, quality management, and process optimization, simplifies access to production insights for non-programmers, supports strategic decision-making across the production chain, and is planned for rollout across its global production network after a successful pilot.
architecture_clues: After a successful pilot phase, ChatGPT will be used throughout the Mercedes-Benz global production network.
Employees' voice inputs are processed anonymously in the Azure cloud.
Production data remains in the MO360 Data Platform rather than being moved into the chatbot layer.
The solution is also exposed through a self-service portal on company devices.
